tests.title: SSC CGL Practice Test 1
tests.description: A 10-question warm-up across quantitative aptitude, reasoning, English and general awareness.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.text: A train travels at 60 km/h. How far does it go in 2.5 hours?

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.text: What is the average of 12, 18, 24 and 30?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.explanation: The differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next difference is 12: 30 + 12 = 42.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text: Pick the odd one out: Apple, Mango, Potato, Banana.
questions.explanation: Potato is a vegetable; the others are fruits.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.text: If A = 1, B = 2, C = 3 and so on, what is the sum of the letters in DOG?

questions.subject: English Language
questions.explanation: 'Rapid' means fast, so 'quick' is the synonym.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.text: Choose the correct sentence: She ___ to school every day.
questions.explanation: A third-person singular subject takes the verb form 'goes' in the simple present.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.text: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra is the capital; Sydney and Melbourne are larger but not the capital.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.text: Who wrote the Indian national anthem, 'Jana Gana Mana'?
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore wrote 'Jana Gana Mana'; 'Vande Mataram' was written by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee.
